Metadata.title: {name} – Explore Your Amazing Body!
Metadata.description: A free, safe, interactive 3D human body explorer for learners aged 1 to 18, from toddlers to Class 11–12 BiPC and NEET students.
Metadata.exploreDescription: Spin, zoom and tap the 3D human body to discover what each part does, explained for your age.
Metadata.partTitle: {name}: what it is and what it does

tips.little: Tap the body and listen! Then tap Organs to find the heart.
tips.skin: Drag the peel slider to see what's under your skin!
tips.muscles: Muscles work in pairs. Find the biceps and the triceps!
tips.organs: Tap an organ, then try Close-up or Cut in half to look inside.
tips.skeleton: Can you find the longest bone? Hint: it's in your leg!
tips.circulatory: Red tubes carry blood away from the heart, blue tubes bring it back.
tips.nervous: Press 'Send a message' and watch it zoom to the hand!
tips.respiratory: Press 'Breathe with me' and breathe along with the lungs.
tips.digestive: Press 'Follow the food' to take a trip through your tummy!
tips.urinary: Your kidneys are near your back. Try the Back view!
tips.sensory: Tap a sense organ and try its experiment.
tips.immune: The spleen and thymus help train your body's defence team.
tips.endocrine: Hormones are chemical messages carried in your blood.
tips.selected: Tap 'Zoom into the tissue' to see what it's made of!
tips.tour: Not sure where to start? Take the body tour!

Explore.heading: Explore the body
Explore.hint: Tap any body part to learn about it!

Explore.chooseAge: First, tell us how old you are so we can explain things just right.

skeletal.name: Skeleton
skeletal.description: Explore the bones of the human skeleton in 3D, from the skull to the tiny bones of the feet.

muscular.name: Muscles
muscular.description: Explore the major muscles in 3D and learn how they pull on bones to move the body.

circulatory.name: Heart and blood vessels
circulatory.description: Explore the heart, arteries and veins in 3D and follow how blood travels around the body.

nervous.name: Nervous system
nervous.description: Explore the brain, spinal cord and nerves in 3D and watch a message travel from the brain to the hand.

respiratory.name: Breathing system
respiratory.description: Explore the nose, windpipe, lungs and diaphragm in 3D, and breathe along with the lungs.

digestive.name: Digestive system
digestive.description: Follow the food from the mouth through the stomach and intestines in 3D.

urinary.name: Urinary system
urinary.description: Explore the kidneys, ureters and bladder in 3D and learn how the body cleans the blood.

sensory.name: Senses
sensory.description: Explore the eyes, ears, nose, mouth and skin in 3D and try a mini experiment for each sense.

immune.name: Immune and lymphatic system
immune.description: Meet the body's defence team: the spleen and thymus, in 3D.

endocrine.name: Endocrine system
endocrine.description: Explore the hormone-making glands in 3D, from the pituitary to the adrenal glands.

Actions.signal: Send a message to the hand!

Micro.tapToLearn: Tap a part of the picture to learn about it.
Micro.canvasLabel: Magnified 3D view. Drag to turn it, and tap a structure to learn about it.

Demos.title: Try it!
Demos.eyeText: In the dark your pupil opens wide to let in more light. In bright light it shrinks to protect your eye.
Demos.earText: Fast vibrations make high sounds and slow vibrations make low sounds. Bigger vibrations sound louder.
Demos.smellText: Tiny smell molecules float from the {thing} into your nose, and your brain works out what it is.
Demos.tastePrompt: Tap a food to taste it!
Demos.tasteText: {food} tastes {taste}. Taste buds all over your tongue can sense all five tastes.
Demos.touchPrompt: Which part of your skin feels the tiniest touch?
Demos.touchText: Your {place} has {level} touch sensors packed close together.
